tasks.title: Conversation #39
tasks.transcript:
Woman: How are preparations for tomorrow’s meeting with the board coming along. Is your marketing presentation all set?
Man: Almost. I’ve finalized the slides, but I still need to print the handouts—and the printer’s acting up.
Woman: Again? That’s the third time this week. Do you want me to check it out? The last couple of times I had an issue, I managed to get it working again.
Man: That would be great. I’ve already tried fiddling with it, but no luck.
Woman: I’ll head down to the copy room right now and see what I can do.

questions.stem: What problem are the speakers discussing?

options.A: A computer file is not opening.
options.B: A piece of equipment is not working.
options.C: A presentation time has been changed.
options.D: Some slides are not displaying properly.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问对话双方正在讨论什么问题，属于主旨 / 事实识别题，需抓住整个对话围绕的中心事件。 选项分析 选项 A：错误。对话未提及电脑文件无法打开，属于凭空捏造信息的干扰项。 选项 B：正确。整段对话围绕 “printer's acting up”（打印机出故障）展开，打印机属于办公设备，“not working” 是对 “acting up” 的准确同义转述。 选项 C：错误。对话未提到演示时间被更改，属于无中生有的干扰项。 选项 D：错误。男士已完成幻灯片，问题不在幻灯片播放，属于细节错位的干扰项。

questions.stem: What does the woman offer to do?

options.C: Help the man practice a presentation
options.D: Make copies of the man's presentation

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士主动提出做什么，属于细节题，需定位对话中女士主动帮忙的关键语句。 选项分析 选项 A：正确。女士主动提出 “do you want me to check it out”，并表示之前修好过打印机，即主动尝试修理打印机。 选项 B：错误。女士未提出检查男士的讲义，属于信息对象错误的干扰项。 选项 C：错误。对话未提及帮助练习演示，属于无中生有的干扰项。 选项 D：错误。女士是修打印机而非帮忙复印，属于细节曲解的干扰项。
